notes: HealthEquity is a non-insurance HSA custodian and benefits administrator, so most insurance-carrier facets do not apply.

insurance_business_line.value: Not an insurer; HSA custodian and consumer-directed benefits administrator (HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA, commuter)

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Bears no insurance underwriting risk; sells administration services to employers, health plans and advisors, and directly to members

premium_exposure_mix.value: No premiums; account-based benefits administration led by HSAs

investment_liability_matching.value: Not an insurer; members can invest HSA funds in mutual funds, not FDIC-insured or guaranteed by the company
